title: Theo and the Safehouse
author: Bram Delacroix
blurb: Petra Winterbourne, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
